calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
mv AS (SELECT m.* FROM dim_member m WHERE DATE '2025-11-24' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h) n_holdout,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM mv)) in_member_at_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM mv WHERE marketing_consent)) consent_at_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) in_dim_any,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM mv WHERE marketing_consent) consenting_at_start,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15) exposed_members,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM h)) exposed_and_held,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=15) stg_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) exp_rows

calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
ex AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ex) ex_n, (SELECT count(*) FROM h) h_n, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM ex UNION SELECT member_id FROM h)) union_n,
(SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e WHERE campaign_id=15 AND member_key IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM h))) exposed_rows_for_held,
(SELECT min(contact_ts_utc)||' '||max(contact_ts_utc) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) span,
(SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15 AND member_id IS NULL) null_ids
